text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. I've got me some special<n>spice today,
Trainer!

Well, I'm feelin' a little better than<n>usual. What is it
people say again?<n>I've got a pop in my step today?
choice_data_list: You mean you've got pep in your step?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's the one! I've got some pep<n>in my step!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If I lose again like last time, it'll give<n>all my fans the
blues.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll come out of this race the winner<n>and throw
everybody a big, happy<n>party!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Anybody who gets in my way is<n>goin' down with a
bang! These legs<n>of mine'll blast them away!
